newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain higher, but momentum slowing.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain higher, but momentum slowing.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained moderately higher at mid-session on Monday, but momentum was stalling as the index approached psychological resistance at 10,000 points, brokers said.
The index pushed steadily to an intra-day high 9,995.37 but failed to make the final push. With 70 minutes left at 0250 GMT, the index was up 78.05 points or 0.79 percent at 9,947.30.
Turnover was moderate at T$119 billion.
THe heavily weighted financials gained 1.47 percent to carry the market, while electronics, which have carried the market for months, fell 0.65 percent on profit-taking.
"The market is experiencing jitters before the 10,000-point mark," said Allen Huang, fund manager of National Securities.
"Electronics need to come out and lead again if the index is to break 10,000," he said.
